overview: Lake Charles Quik Reference is Bubba's 33 Roadie training app with prep recipe cards that now show Quality Identifiers in separate labeled sets when a recipe has multiple quality groups.
features: Show prep recipe cards with step sections, quality identifiers, and batch sizes
Render multi-set Quality Identifiers as separate labeled sets each with its own shelf life, storage, and temp
Keep single-set recipes unchanged with a flat quality list and single badges
Import recipe files including the new qualityGroups data
